title: Rising GUE Eigenvalue Process from a Fixed Level
summary: We construct the multilevel correlation kernel for the rising GUE eigenvalue process starting from a fixed initial configuration $x^{(m)}$, and show that it converges on short time scales (as quickly as $\text{polylog}(m)$) to the extended semi-discrete sine kernel. As an application, we show fixed-energy universality of bulk local statistics of complex Hermitian Wigner matrices matching the covariance structure of GUE and with a finite $4+\varepsilon$ moment for $\varepsilon>0$.
